posts.text: Pax Global slashed its annual dividend by 75.8%, cutting the payout from HK$0.33 to HK$0.08.
Diageo cut its annual dividend by 39.8%, dropping the rate from $3.32 to $2.00.
Allwyn AG hiked its annual dividend by 40%, raising the payout from €0.50 to €0.70.
Nike now yields 4.37%, 3.1 times its 5-year average. The company has increased its dividend for 23 consecutive years.
Realty Income goes ex-dividend on Oct 30. The real estate firm has a 28-year streak of increases and a 5.74% yield.
Dick's Sporting Goods posted 31.1% five-year dividend growth and now yields 3.53%.
Intertek reduced its annual dividend by 34.5%, lowering the payout from £1.65 to £1.08.
Texas Instruments raised its annual dividend by 7.0% to $6.08, maintaining a 22-year streak of increases.
